items.content_html: I built a lightweight Location Reminder web app as part of the AI for Bharat Week-1 Micro Tools Challenge. The tool allows users to click on a map, create a geofence with a custom radius, and get an alarm when they enter that area. It includes real-time GPS tracking, reminder management (create/edit/delete), and local storage persistence.
